name: Motorcycle Simulator Iowa
summary:
Ride Des Moines, Iowa, from the seat - on your own or with your friends.

44 KM ROUND DES MOINES
I-235 past the gold dome of the Iowa State Capitol, under the downtown towers and 801 Grand, past Drake University to West Des Moines, then I-35 / I-80 round the city and over the Des Moines River. Real roads, real interchanges, real skyline.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
